descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Load for tasks like "look at X under the desklamp" or "examine X with the floorlamp": find the object, take it, and turn on the lamp. Use whenever a lamp is in the task.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Load for simple tasks "put a X in/on Y" with one object and no hot/cold/clean wording, no lamp, and no "two". Take the object and place it at the destination.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Load when the task says "clean X" and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet"). Take the object, wash it at the sinkbasin, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Load when the task says "cool X", "cold X", or "chilled X" and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table"). Take the object, cool it in the fridge, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Load when the task says "heat X", "hot X", or "warm X" and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop"). Take the object, heat it in the microwave, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Load when the task says "two" of an object, e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa" or "put two cds in the drawer". Find and place two separate objects of the same kind, one at a time.
